data.content: # Predicted line-ups for Premier League teams in Matchweek 6. Football writers David Coverdale and Ben Bloom have predicted the line-ups of every Premier League club in action this weekend. ##### Arsenal v Leeds predicted line-ups. **Arsenal:** Viktor Gyokeres is in line to make his first Premier League start of the season after Kai Havertz suffered a hamstring injury for Germany in the international break. Greek winger Christos Tzolis also got injured during the break and is definitely out of the Leeds match, according to Mikel Arteta, which could mean a start for Eberechi Eze. Another Arsenal player who picked up an injury on international duty was Ezri Konsa, opening the door for Cristhian Mosquera to make his first appearance since August in central defence. Moises Caicedo is in line to start his first Premier League match of the season after recovering from injury, and he could partner Reece James, who has also been passed fit.
